_note: Small Juniper SRX rule subset mapping to the same NormalizedConfig fields. Depth over breadth — proves schema generalizes.

rules.cis_section: Ensure SSH is configured for device management (no Telnet)
rules.remediation_cli: delete system services telnet; set system services ssh

rules.cis_section: Ensure SSH idle-timeout is configured (10 minutes or less)
Ensure J-Web / HTTP management is disabled
Ensure centralized syslog host is configured
rules.remediation_cli: set system syslog host <server> any any

rules.cis_section: Ensure NTP is configured for time synchronization
Ensure security policy deny actions log to SIEM
rules.remediation_cli: set security policies ... then deny log
